purpose: PHX frozen PAMRVQ interface with a local masked parallel generator; heterogeneous AR/mask architectures.
scheduler_semantics: Preserve original warmup function and scheduler stepping only after warmup. Scheduler milestones count post-warmup optimizer steps.
motion_loss: Global1344-class CE only at corrupted action-token positions. No EOS/BOS/PAD target is introduced. Batch CE is normalized by corrupted action-token count.
length_loss: SmoothL1(log predicted token length, log complete token length) on original conditioned text. Mask source_truncated rows for this loss only, retain their prefix action denoising loss. No inferred full-length token target.

validation.ce_aggregation: preserve original batch CE weighted by batch sample count

sampling.per_sample_rng: same SHA256 dataset/split/sample_id derivation as revised AR
sampling.length_source: text-only length head, exp(log length), round to nearest complete6-token group, clamp to[6,480]
sampling.group_legality: mask logits outside each position's declared group before sampling, never modulo-remap wrong-group codes
sampling.actual_update: inherit frozen model.sample: already revealed tokens remain unchanged, MASK positions reveal with probability t_next. No remasking of already revealed tokens despite old comments.
sampling.end_condition: fixed text-predicted complete-group length, no EOS

reporting: Report quantizer and generator hashes and the actual text/length/sampling conditions; this is an interface experiment, not equal-model-budget comparison.
